title: Prefixes and conversion of units
competency: Identify prefixes and convert among units of length, mass and time.

keywords.def: A short-hand way of writing very large or very small numbers in a unit, like kilo (1000) or milli (0.001).

en.text: A prefix is a short way to write very large or very small amounts: mega (M) = 1 000 000, kilo (k) = 1000, centi (c) = 0.01, milli (m) = 0.001, micro (µ) = 0.000001. So 1 km = 1000 m and 1 mm = 0.001 m.

am.text: ቅድመ ቅጥያ ትልቅና ትንሽ መጠኖችን በአጭሩ ለመጻፍ ይረዳል፤ ኪሎ = 1000፣ ሴንቲ = 0.01፣ ሚሊ = 0.001።

screens.title: A shorter way
screens.ask: The distance from Addis Ababa to Adama is about 99 000 m. What is a shorter way to say it?

screens.title: Prefixes
paras: Science deals with very large and very small quantities.
A short-hand way of writing them is a prefix.

screens.title: What each prefix does
screens.ask: Tap a prefix to see it at work.

screens.title: One length, three prefixes
screens.note: The length stays the same. A big unit (km) gives a small number; a small unit (mm) gives a big number.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A short-hand way of writing very large or very small numbers in a unit, like kilo (1000) or milli (0.001).

screens.why:
1/1000 is one thousandth = 0.001.
Milli means a thousandth: 1 mm = 0.001 m.
Kilo means a thousand (1000), not a thousandth.
Centi is a hundredth (0.01); mega is a million.
So the answer is milli.

screens.ask: Prefixes: the prefix for 0.01 (one hundredth) is ___
screens.why:
0.01 = 1/100, one hundredth.
Table 1.3: centi = hundredth.
So 1 cm = 0.01 m, and 100 cm = 1 m.
The answer is centi (c).
screens.clue: A hundredth: 100 of them make a metre.

screens.text: Using prefixes: write 3500 m with a prefix.
screens.why:
Kilo means 1000, so 1 km = 1000 m.
To change m to km, divide by 1000.
3500 ÷ 1000 = 3.5.
So 3500 m = 3.5 km.
35 km would be 35 000 m: ten times too big.

screens.text: Using prefixes: write 0.005 m with a prefix.
screens.why:
Milli means 0.001, so 1 mm = 0.001 m.
How many 0.001s are in 0.005?
0.005 ÷ 0.001 = 5.
So 0.005 m = 5 mm.
0.5 mm would be only 0.0005 m.

screens.text: Choosing a prefix: a tiny bacterium is 0.000002 m long. Which is the best way to write it?
screens.why:
The number is very small: 0.000002 m.
Micro (µ) means a millionth, 0.000001.
0.000002 ÷ 0.000001 = 2.
So it is 2 µm.
2 mm = 0.002 m: a thousand times too big.

en.text: To convert inside the SI, multiply or divide by the value of the prefix. Big unit to small unit: multiply (6.5 kg = 6.5 × 1000 g = 6500 g). Small unit to big unit: divide (200 m = 200 ÷ 1000 km = 0.2 km). For time: 1 hour = 60 min = 3600 s.

am.text: ከትልቅ ወደ ትንሽ መለኪያ ስንቀይር እናባዛለን፤ ከትንሽ ወደ ትልቅ ስንቀይር እናካፍላለን። 6.5 ኪ.ግ = 6500 ግ፤ 200 ሜ = 0.2 ኪ.ሜ።

screens.title: Big to small
screens.ask: Is 2.5 kg more grams or fewer grams than 2.5?
screens.after: More. A gram is small, so you need many of them: 2.5 × 1000 = 2500 g.

screens.title: Conversion of base units
paras: Converting within the SI usually means moving the decimal point.
Multiply or divide by the value of the prefix.

screens.title: Climb the unit ladder: 25 000 mm to km
screens.intro: Going up to a bigger unit: divide. Tap ▶ for each step.
say: 25 m ÷ 1000 = 0.025 km. Bigger unit, smaller number.

screens.title: Hours into minutes and seconds
screens.note: 1 hour = 60 min and 1 min = 60 s, so 1 hour = 60 × 60 = 3600 s.

screens.title: Key word again
defs: A short-hand way of writing very large or very small numbers in a unit, like kilo (1000) or milli (0.001).

screens.title: Example 1.3: 200 m to km
steps: Metres are smaller than kilometres, so divide.

screens.ask: Example 1.2, kilograms to grams: 6.5 kg = ___ g
screens.why:
1 kg = 1000 g.
A gram is smaller, so you need more of them: multiply.
6.5 × 1000 = 6500.
So 6.5 kg = 6500 g.
screens.clue: Big unit to small unit: multiply.

screens.ask: Convert grams to kilograms: 500 g = ___ kg
screens.why:
1 kg = 1000 g.
A kilogram is bigger, so you get fewer: divide.
500 ÷ 1000 = 0.5.
So 500 g = 0.5 kg, half a kilogram.

screens.ask: Convert kilometres to centimetres: 0.6 km = ___ cm
screens.clue: Two steps: km to m, then m to cm.

screens.ask: Convert hours to seconds: 0.5 hour = ___ s
screens.why:
1 hour = 60 min and 1 min = 60 s.
So 1 hour = 60 × 60 = 3600 s.
0.5 × 3600 = 1800 s.
Check: half an hour is 30 min, and 30 × 60 = 1800 s.

screens.ask: Convert days to minutes: one day = ___ minutes
screens.why:
1 day = 24 hours.
1 hour = 60 minutes.
24 × 60 = 1440.
So one day = 1440 minutes.
screens.clue: Hours in a day × minutes in an hour.

screens.ask: Convert centimetres to kilometres: 1000 cm = ___ km
Speed in metres per second: a runner in the Great Ethiopian Run covers 10 km in 30 minutes. That is ___ metres per second (to 1 decimal place)
screens.why:
Change km to m: 10 × 1000 = 10 000 m.
Change min to s: 30 × 60 = 1800 s.
Speed = distance ÷ time.
10 000 ÷ 1800 = 5.55…
To 1 decimal place: 5.6 m/s.
screens.clue: Change km to m and minutes to seconds first.
screens.worked:
Step 1, km to m: 10 × 1000 = 10 000 m.
Step 2, min to s: 30 × 60 = 1800 s.
Step 3, speed = distance ÷ time = 10 000 ÷ 1800 = 5.555…
To 1 decimal place: about 5.6 m/s.

items.ask: Convert minutes to hours: 30 min = ___ hour
items.why:
1 hour = 60 min.
An hour is bigger, so divide.
30 ÷ 60 = 0.5.
So 30 min = 0.5 hour, half an hour.

items.ask: Convert metres to millimetres: 50 m = ___ mm
items.why:
1 m = 1000 mm.
A millimetre is smaller, so multiply.
50 × 1000 = 50 000.
So 50 m = 50 000 mm.

items.ask: Convert kilograms to grams: 0.25 kg = ___ g
items.why:
1 kg = 1000 g.
Multiply: 0.25 × 1000 = 250.
So 0.25 kg = 250 g, a quarter of a kilogram.

items.text: Using prefixes: write 0.0012 s with a prefix.
items.why:
Milli means 0.001: 1 ms = 0.001 s.
0.0012 ÷ 0.001 = 1.2.
So 0.0012 s = 1.2 ms.
12 ms would be 0.012 s: ten times too big.

items.ask: Convert kilograms to grams: 2.5 kg = ___ g
items.why:
1 kg = 1000 g.
Big unit to small unit: multiply.
2.5 × 1000 = 2500.
So 2.5 kg = 2500 g.

items.ask: Convert grams to milligrams: 200 g = ___ mg
items.why:
1 g = 1000 mg.
Big unit to small unit: multiply.
200 × 1000 = 200 000.
So 200 g = 200 000 mg.

items.ask: Convert metres to kilometres: 5500 m = ___ km
items.why:
1 km = 1000 m.
A kilometre is bigger, so divide.
5500 ÷ 1000 = 5.5.
So 5500 m = 5.5 km.

items.ask: Convert days to seconds: one day = ___ seconds

test.ask: Convert metres to millimetres: 8 m = ___ mm
test.why:
1 m = 1000 mm.
Big unit to small unit: multiply.
8 × 1000 = 8000.
So 8 m = 8000 mm.

Kilo (k) means a thousand.
1 km = 1000 m and 1 kg = 1000 g.
0.001 is milli, and 1 000 000 is mega.
So kilo = 1000.

test.ask: Convert grams to kilograms: 1200 g = ___ kg
test.why:
1 kg = 1000 g.
Small unit to big unit: divide.
1200 ÷ 1000 = 1.2.
So 1200 g = 1.2 kg.

test.ask: Convert centimetres to metres: one million centimetres = ___ m
test.why:
One million = 1 000 000.
100 cm = 1 m, so divide by 100.
1 000 000 ÷ 100 = 10 000.
So one million cm = 10 000 m.
